description_en: Changes the port for the O\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\&M protocol on one or more hosts
description_zh: 堡垒机对于服务器的RDP和SSH协议使用的是默认端口（RDP协议默认使用3389端口，SSH协议默认使用22端口），如果您在主机中自定义了端口，可通过本接口进行修改
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-hosts-port --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --protocol-name SSH --port 22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHostsPort

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to change the port of the host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
要修改协议端口的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to change the port of the host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要修改端口的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host for which you want to change the port. The value is a JSON string. You can add up to 100 host IDs. If you specify multiple IDs, separate the IDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the IDs of hosts
parameters.help_zh:
要修改运维协议和端口的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多可输入100个主机ID。多个主机ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_ids

parameters.help_en:
The protocol that is used to connect to the host. Valid values:

SSH

RDP
parameters.help_zh:
要修改端口的协议名称。取值：
SSH
RDP
parameters.name: protocol_name

parameters.help_en: The new port of the host. The port number must be an integer. Valid values: 22 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的端口号。端口号为整数，取值范围：22~65535
parameters.name: port

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Code.description_en:
The return code that indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

OK: The call was successful.

UNEXPECTED: An unknown error occurred.

INVALID_ARGUMENT: A request parameter is invalid.

Make sure that the request parameters are valid and call the operation again.

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND: The specified object on which you want to perform the operation does not exist.

Check whether the specified ID of the bastion host exists, whether the specified hosts exist, and whether the specified host IDs are valid. Then, call the operation again.

OBJECT_AlREADY_EXISTS: The specified object on which you want to perform the operation already exists
Code.description_zh:
接口调用的结果。取值：
OK：操作成功。
UNEXPECTED：未知错误。
INVALID_ARGUMENT：请求参数设置错误。

请检查请求参数，确保参数正确后重新调用接口。

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND：操作的对象不存在。

请检查该堡垒机实例的ID是否存在，主机是否存在，主机ID是否填写正确，然后重新调用接口。

OBJECT_AlREADY_EXISTS ：操作的对象已存在

Message.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需关注
